data.title: Ohana By The Sea
data.about:
Ohana Villas by the Sea blends modern architecture with natural beauty, creating a unique living experience by the waterfront. Residents can enjoy direct access to beaches, scenic canals, and a vibrant community atmosphere, making it an ideal destination for those seeking tranquility without compromising on luxury.

Ohana Villas by Ohana Development offers a range of property options, from 4 to 7-bedroom villas and mansions to branded apartments, catering to various lifestyles. With thoughtfully designed retail spaces integrated into the development, villas for sale in Ohana By The Sea, Ghantoot ensures that residents have access to all essential amenities within a beautiful, resort-like setting.

characteristics_module.title: Make Your Dream Home Uniquely Yours with Ohana Villas!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Connectivity: Enjoy direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road, connecting you to the heart of Dubai.
  • Diverse Property Options: Ohana Villas by the Sea Abu Dhabi an exceptional range of seafront mansions, villas, and branded apartments, tailored to your lifestyle.
  • Exclusive Beach Access: Experience the luxury of direct beach access for serene waterfront living.
  • Branded Retail: Convenient branded retail spaces within the community to meet all your daily needs.
  • Luxurious Master Suites: Each unit features spacious master suites with his and her wardrobes for ultimate comfort.
  • Premium Finishes: Elegant interiors with exquisite porcelain tiles and porcelain wooden flooring throughout.
  • Sustainable Living: Benefit from sustainable and innovative air-cooling systems that promote energy efficiency.
  • Impressive Design: Welcome guests with an impressive double-height entry, adding grandeur to your home.
  • Customizable Floor Plans: Enjoy the freedom to customize your floor plan and update the landscape at villas for sale in Ohana By The Sea, Ghantoot.

location_tile.title: Ohana Villas by the Sea – Where Luxury Meets Tranquility
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Ohana Villas by the Sea is located in Ghantoot, Abu Dhabi, offering a peaceful coastal lifestyle between two major cities—Abu Dhabi and Dubai. With direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road, residents enjoy excellent connectivity, making it easy to commute to both urban hubs.

The serene beachfront setting provides a perfect escape from city life, while essential destinations like Yas Island, Dubai Marina, and Al Maktoum International Airport are just a short drive away. This location ensures that residents can experience the best of waterfront living with easy access to shopping, leisure, and business centers across the UAE.

  • Walking Distance from the Beach
  • Walking Distance to the Public Gardens
  • 15 Minutes to Ghantoot Racing & Polo Club
  • 20 Minutes to Dubai Parks and Resorts
  • 20 Minutes to Dubai Marina Mall
  • 45 Minutes to Yas Abu Dhabi
